(one of several possible spawn points) | map2 = [[File:Pockmark Flats devourer bosses map.jpg|150px]] | map2-text = In Pockmark Flats | map3 = [[File:Ruins of Surmia Devourer bosses map.jpg|150px]] | map3-text = In [[Ruins of Surmia]] }} [[Hurl Foulspine]] is a [[Devourer]] [[boss]] found in several places around [[Ascalon]]. == Locations == * [[Ascalon]] ** {{NPC location|Eastern Frontier}} ** {{NPC location|Pockmark Flats}} == Missions == * Ascalon ** {{NPC location|Ruins of Surmia}} == Skills == * None == Items dropped == * [[Chitin Fragment]] * [[Fetid Carapace]] * [[Half-Eaten Mass]] == Notes == * Despite his Ranger [[Boss#aura|aura]], he will attack in [[melee range]] like a [[Carrion Devourer]]. ** He is the only Ranger Devourer boss that shares models with a Carrion Devourer. * In [[Ruins of Surmia]], this boss shares three [[spawn]] locations with two other Devourer bosses ([[Fester Fang]] and [[Gnash Underfoot]]); however, one of the three will spawn in a sealed off area near the location of [[Breena Stavinson]] (point 2 on the wiki map) that cannot be reached by the [[party]].
